heads.first: **A job's box now opens on the day you tapped.** Before, if you tapped a day that Simpro has a job booked but that isn't one of the job's planned days, the box opened on the first planned day instead,

**Temp peds don't disappear on a missed tap.** Tapping the TEMP PED chip anywhere now opens its menu instead of flipping the ped on or off. Before, missing the little arrow could clear the Ped # and d
**Every job is on the board.** Quick jobs (with or without a job #), temp ped pickups and temp ped jobs now show in Office Admin until they're done, each with a small tag by its name.

heads.h: NEW on the Foreman Meeting (office and foremen)
heads.first: **Each job's reports open right from the meeting.** Under each job in Jobs, tap **Reports** to see that job's reports, the newest Job Report first, then Margin Watch and post-rough-in. Tap one to read

**Book in Simpro handles split days and the right cost center.** It adds a second piece of a day to the same Simpro schedule instead of failing, and books to the cost center the work belongs to (a cha
**New cost centers show up right away.** When the office moves a change order into a job in Simpro (a new section like "Change Order - 11/19/26"), Bid Items used to keep showing the old bid for up to

**A what-if view: "If all start on estimate".** A new button in the calendar's top bar lays every upcoming job that has an estimated start date out on that date, even though the start isn't confirmed.
**Duet no longer counts a company holiday as a day everyone is idle.** Its calendar read listed the whole crew as open on Thanksgiving. It now marks the holiday and lists nobody open that day.

**Answer job flags right on the calendar.** Each flag in a job's box is now the same card as Needs you on the Claude tab, with the same buttons: Yes or No on a change, Schedule it, Add to my tasks, Do
Jobs under Job flags, not on the calendar open the same cards.

**Take a job off one day and leave the rest.** Remove used to take the whole job off the calendar. Now, on a job of two or more days, Remove first asks about just the day you tapped. "Off this day, ho
**Book in Simpro looked like it did nothing.** On a job with a long box, the booking part opened below the bottom edge where you couldn't see it. It now scrolls into view when you tap Book in Simpro.
Removing the whole job works the same as before, same number of taps.

**Open job flags show on the calendar.** A job with open flags from Claude's watches (a missing PO, open punch, missing info) now has a small purple mark on its block with how many. Tap the job and th
Flags are still answered and closed in Needs you on the Claude tab. A closed flag drops off the calendar.
**Each person on a job can have their own time.** People can now be on the same job for part of the day. Say two guys finish a short visit somewhere and join a crew at 11:30: they go on the job 11:30
Full day, Half day and Custom in the job box now set everyone on that day at once.
A return trip you mark complete now comes off next week's calendar. Before, a block someone had placed for it could hang on in red.
A return trip's block now says what the trip is for, under the job name. Two trips on the same job no longer look alike.

heads.h: NEW on the dashboard Meetings tab
heads.first: Claude can now add items to the Lead Meeting, the Foreman Meeting and the Friday Strategy when Koy asks, this week or a week ahead. They show tagged Added, with "Added by Claude". Remove one like any

Needs you now also lists blocks a person placed that have a problem: a day with nobody on it, or one person alone. It says who and which day. A lead or foreman whose partner is off that day isn't list
Someone on leave in Simpro now shows as Off on the calendar, even if their time-off request in the app isn't approved yet. Before, they showed as open.

Warranty work books to the job's Warranty cost center. If Finish or Rough In is already invoiced, the booking goes to Warranty instead and the preview says so. If the job has no open Warranty cost cen
"How you schedule": a fold on the left with the rules Duet follows when it suggests blocks. Duet can propose a rule when it sees a pattern. Nothing counts until an admin taps Approve. Admins can also
The Forecast tab now opens on the crew calendar. The Crew Planner button is gone; the crew calendar replaced it. A small "Old Crew Planner" link at the end of the row still opens the old board if you
Fridays have a "Said yes" list. Tap "Add who said yes", tick the people, and their names show on that Friday to drag onto a job.
Book now refuses someone who is off, not on a crew, or on a holiday or weekend, even if the screen missed it.
Duet (Koy's assistant) can now suggest a block on the calendar. It shows with a dotted green outline and says "Duet suggests", with the reason.
A flag that would change a job's start date now says, before you tap Yes, whether the GC gets emailed.

heads.h: NEW for admins: copy and share Claude reports
heads.first: Dashboard, Claude tab, Reports: open a report and tap Copy. Pick Foreman / crew or Owners / admins, and Text or Email, then Copy and paste it anywhere.
If someone sends you a report link, open it on your phone, sign in if asked, and the report opens over the app. Copy text is at the bottom.

heads.h: NEW on the dashboard meetings (office and leads)
heads.first: The Scramble, Lead and Foreman Meetings fill themselves from the app the first time each week's meeting opens. Prefill again at the top makes a fresh one.
